facts.fact: 叙述者交代主人公开篇的真名是 Augustus Owsley Stanley III，绰号“The Dancing Bear”。
facts.anchor: his full true name was Augustus Owsley Stanley III

facts.fact: 他于 1963 年 11 月 12 日星期二、二十八岁入职 CIA，被 The Pseudo Guy 命名为 Barrington Q. GRIZZLYBOTTOM。
facts.anchor: entered on duty with CIA back on Tuesday, November 12th, 1963, at age twenty-eight

facts.fact: 他在 CIA 的掩护身份是特种化学品，真正专注的只有 LSD 这一种化学品。
facts.anchor: Owsley’s CIA cover was in specialty chemicals

facts.fact: Fagen 与已故的 Becker 合写《Kid Charlemagne》，把 Owsley 唱成城里最好的制酸者。
facts.anchor: Donald Fagen and the late Walter Becker said so in this song they co-wrote about Owsley Stanley called “Kid Charlemagne.”

facts.fact: 1942 年 OSS 在找一种能用在被俘纳粹身上的吐真剂，这项计划由 Donovan 将军发起。
facts.anchor: It was 1942, see, and OSS was looking for a truth serum it could use on captured Nazis

facts.fact: McCone 问 Owsley 是否爱国，得到肯定回答后当场当众解雇他；随后又在绿停车场秘密重新雇用他去执行深度卧底任务。
facts.anchor: Director McCone fired him on the spot and made sure everybody within earshot heard it

facts.fact: 1965 至 1967 年间他制造并发放了超过四百五十万剂 LSD。
facts.anchor: between 1965 and 1967 he fabricated and dispensed over four and a half million doses of the stuff

facts.fact: 他获准保留给 Grateful Dead 当音响师的报酬，连同售酸与盗版录音收入共约 720 万美元且免税。
facts.anchor: Owsley got special permission from the Director to keep the pay he earned as Sound Man to the Grateful Dead
